description: Source code for trust store management in Chromium, including trust type definitions, trust evaluation methods, and string serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: CertificateTrust
classes.description: Represents the trust level of a certificate, with methods to determine trust properties and serialize/deserialize trust states.

classes.name: TrustStore
classes.description: Manages a collection of trusted certificates and provides asynchronous issuer retrieval.

methods.name: IsTrustAnchor
methods.description: Determines if the trust object is a trust anchor.

methods.name: IsTrustLeaf
methods.description: Checks if the trust object is a trust leaf.

methods.name: IsDistrusted
methods.description: Checks if the trust object is explicitly distrusted.

methods.name: HasUnspecifiedTrust
methods.description: Checks if the trust object has an unspecified trust level.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the trust object for debugging.

methods.name: FromDebugString
methods.description: Parses a string to create a trust object.

methods.name: AsyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.
